conditions.evidence: underwent bronchoalveolar lavage sampling because of pneumonia suspicion
conditions.label: pneumonia

modalities.evidence: 113 clinical parameters for which data are present including vital signs, laboratory parameters, and mechanical support devices

output.population: 704 patients enrolled in the SCRIPT study between June 2018 and May 2023, all of whom were critically ill patients on mechanical ventilation suspected of having pneumonia
output.summary: Per-day clinical parameters, demographics, physician-adjudicated pneumonia episode information and outcomes for critically ill mechanically ventilated patients who underwent bronchoalveolar lavage. Deidentified under HIPAA Safe Harbor.
